title: Subsets II
statement:
Given an integer array nums that may contain duplicates, return all possible subsets (the power set).
The solution set must not contain duplicate subsets.

Return each distinct subset once, with values inside each subset sorted ascending and the outer list sorted lexicographically by subset.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: nums = [1,2,2]
Output: [[],[1],[1,2],[1,2,2],[2],[2,2]]
```

### Example 2

```text
Input: nums = [0]
Output: [[],[0]]
```

## Constraints

- 1 ≤ nums.length ≤ 10
- -10 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10
